title: Preserve upstream version priority when normalizing discovery
answers: How does the router choose a discovered group's preferred API version?
Why must aggregated discovery versions retain their order?
How should APIGroupDiscoveryList be converted for router discovery?
body:
pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups normalizes aggregated discovery into the classic metav1.APIGroup shape expected by the router.
Preserve each group's upstream version order and construct GroupVersion as group name + "/" + version.
Set PreferredVersion to the first converted version only when versions are present; changing the order changes the preferred version advertised by the router.
applies: Conversion of aggregated APIGroupDiscoveryList responses into classic router discovery groups.
